evidence.note: Dark green camping chair is tightly folded and stowed in the corner by the doorway-side wall.
Chair fabric fills the foreground as the chair is being unfolded.
Chair is spread out with its seat, arms, and support frame deployed.
Chair remains deployed immediately before the closing action.
Chair is folded back into a compact bundle in the corner.

events.object_description: Dark green folding camping chair in the corner beside the doorway-side wall

evidence.note: Second dark green camping chair is folded in the corner beside the bright window.
Expanded fabric enters close view during unfolding.
Chair is visibly upright and fully deployed beside the desk/window.
Chair is still open near the end of its active interval.
Chair is again compactly folded and stowed in the window corner.

events.object_description: Dark green folding camping chair in the blank-wall/window corner

evidence.note: Blue folding camping chair is collapsed in the corner between the bed-side wall and window.
Blue chair fabric fills the foreground during unfolding.
Blue chair is upright with seat, back, arms, and legs deployed.
Chair is partly out of view with motion blur during the closing action.
Blue chair is compactly folded back into the corner.

events.object_description: Blue folding camping chair in the corner beside the bed and window

notes: Three distinct localized unfold–hold–refold episodes are visible. Camera-only surveys before, between, and after them were not counted.
scene_description: A bright bedroom/office containing a bed, standing desk, and several folding camping chairs stored in separate corners.
